21:class ClimateSignalMapper(private val profile: ClimatePlatformProfile = DefaultClimatePlatformProfile) {
22:    fun command(command: ClimateCommand): Triple<Int, Int, Float> = when (command) {
23:        is ClimateCommand.SetTemperature -> Triple(profile.propertyId(ClimateSignalKey.TEMPERATURE), command.zone.areaId, command.value.value)
24:        is ClimateCommand.SetFan -> {
25:            require(command.level <= profile.maximumFanLevel)
26:            Triple(profile.propertyId(ClimateSignalKey.FAN_LEVEL), command.zone.areaId, command.level.toFloat())
27:        }
28:        is ClimateCommand.SetSeatHeat -> Triple(profile.propertyId(ClimateSignalKey.SEAT_HEAT), command.zone.areaId, command.level.toFloat())
29:        is ClimateCommand.SetAuto -> Triple(profile.propertyId(ClimateSignalKey.AUTO_MODE), 0, if (command.enabled) 1f else 0f)
30:        is ClimateCommand.SetRecirculation -> Triple(profile.propertyId(ClimateSignalKey.RECIRCULATION), 0, if (command.enabled) 1f else 0f)
31:    }
32:
33:    fun apply(state: ClimateState, signal: ClimateSignal): ClimateState {
34:        if (!signal.isAvailable) return state
35:        val zone = CabinZone.entries.firstOrNull { it.areaId == signal.areaId }
36:        val next = when (signal.propertyId) {
37:            profile.propertyId(ClimateSignalKey.TEMPERATURE) -> zone?.let {
38:                state.withZone(it) { current -> current.copy(temperature = TemperatureCelsius(signal.value)) }
39:            } ?: state
40:            profile.propertyId(ClimateSignalKey.FAN_LEVEL) -> zone?.let {
41:                state.withZone(it) { current -> current.copy(fanLevel = signal.value.toInt()) }
42:            } ?: state
43:            profile.propertyId(ClimateSignalKey.SEAT_HEAT) -> zone?.let {
44:                state.withZone(it) { current -> current.copy(seatHeatLevel = signal.value.toInt()) }
45:            } ?: state
46:            profile.propertyId(ClimateSignalKey.AUTO_MODE) -> state.copy(autoMode = signal.value >= 0.5f)
47:            profile.propertyId(ClimateSignalKey.RECIRCULATION) -> state.copy(recirculation = signal.value >= 0.5f)
48:            else -> state
49:        }
50:        return next.copy(revision = maxOf(next.revision + 1, signal.timestampNanos))
51:    }
52:
53:    private fun ClimateState.withZone(zone: CabinZone, update: (ZoneClimate) -> ZoneClimate): ClimateState {
54:        val current = zones[zone] ?: ZoneClimate(zone, TemperatureCelsius(22f), 0, 0, true)
55:        return copy(zones = zones + (zone to update(current)))
56:    }

22:        val rejected = mutableListOf<RejectedComfortAction>()

24:            val ranked = candidates.sortedWith(
25:                compareByDescending<ComfortAction> { it.priority }
26:                    .thenBy { it.expiresAfter }
27:                    .thenBy { it.rationale },

34:                } else {

26:    val occurrences: Int,
27:    val finding: DiagnosticFinding,
28:    val acknowledged: Boolean,
29:)

31:class IncidentLedger(private val expiry: Duration) {
32:    private val incidents = linkedMapOf<String, Incident>()
33:
34:    @Synchronized fun record(finding: DiagnosticFinding): Incident {
35:        val key = "${finding.detectorId}:${finding.code}:${finding.affectedZones.sortedBy { it.name }}"
36:        val current = incidents[key]
37:        val updated = if (current == null) {
38:            Incident(key, finding.observedAt, finding.observedAt, 1, finding, false)
39:        } else {
40:            current.copy(lastObservedAt = finding.observedAt, occurrences = current.occurrences + 1, finding = finding)
41:        }
42:        incidents[key] = updated
43:        expire(finding.observedAt)
44:        return updated
45:    }
46:
47:    @Synchronized fun acknowledge(key: String): Boolean {
48:        val current = incidents[key] ?: return false
49:        incidents[key] = current.copy(acknowledged = true)
50:        return true
51:    }
52:
53:    @Synchronized fun active(now: Instant): List<Incident> {
54:        expire(now)
55:        return incidents.values.sortedWith(compareByDescending<Incident> { it.finding.severity }.thenBy { it.firstObservedAt })
56:    }
